title: Drone-CV: simulation-first obstacle avoidance
goal: Sửa contract an toàn trước; chuẩn bị OMP; triển khai G0–G4 với oracle độc lập, đạt ít nhất 45/50 world tĩnh ở G3, không unsafe event trong acceptance suite, không tuyên bố bay thật.

tasks.title: Sửa lỗ hổng contract và dependency gate
acceptance: Định nghĩa contact/clearance theo phase, không miễn trừ va chạm tuỳ ý.
Oracle và supervisor tối thiểu có trước flight/wall-stop; không còn dependency vòng.
Outcome unsafe được latch; deadline, suite membership và rollout scope được định nghĩa.
tasks.note: Đã sửa S01–S08 trong SAFETY/PLAN/HARNESS và scenario liên quan: phase-aware contact/clearance, oracle/supervisor trước flight, unsafe latch, frozen suite semantics, coverage/clock/signed-input/route constraints. Inspection giữ đủ 65 ID và link hợp lệ. Đây là contract repair, chưa có runtime proof.

tasks.title: Chuẩn bị bộ skills OMP theo trigger
acceptance: Router chỉ tham chiếu skills hiện có đã đọc; không sao chép bundle hoặc đổi account/policy.
AGENTS hướng dẫn native roadmap và load-on-demand; không giả có auto-hook hay ROS skill đã cài.
tasks.note: Đã chuẩn bị router 10 skills hiện có trong docs/OMP.md và liên kết từ .omp/AGENTS.md; kiểm tra tên/frontmatter và path thực. Load-on-demand, không cài skill/hook/MCP, không đổi settings/model/quyền. Native roadmap là trạng thái duy nhất; robotics contracts dùng docs project, không giả có ROS skill.

tasks.title: Hoàn thiện roadmap và tài liệu vận hành
acceptance: DAG bao phủ G0–G4 và decision gate G5; chỉ chuẩn bị được đánh dấu done.
Canonical JSON/view được tạo bởi native tool; link tài liệu hợp lệ; không tạo receipt bay giả.
tasks.note: Native roadmap có 27 task, DAG không chu trình; oracle/supervisor trước flight và calibration trước wall-stop. 24 task triển khai/bàn giao/quyết định còn pending; chỉ 3 prep task done. 24 link nội bộ hợp lệ, native canvas tồn tại; generated view/locks được ignore, JSON canonical được giữ. Không có flight receipt hoặc phase acceptance giả.

tasks.title: Depth validity, units và clock contract offline
acceptance: API NumPy thật phân biệt valid/too-close/no-return/unknown và encoding mét/mm.
Reject config vô lý, invalid/future/stale input theo clock epoch; test E01/E04/E08/E20 có expected độc lập.
Chạy fixture qua API không ROS/GPU, không sửa input của caller.
tasks.note: 15 depth/clock regressions pass; actual API smoke converts 16UC1 to unknown/too-close/4m and rejects epoch reset. Verified encoding/dtype/config, opt-in REP117 near/far, immutable outputs and caller input preservation. No ROS/GPU or flight evidence.

tasks.title: Projection, frame transforms và conservative coverage
acceptance: Projection optical/FLU/ENU/NED và quaternion có đáp án analytic, intrinsics/crop đúng.
Histogram 72x3 giữ near evidence, unknown và wrap; footprint inflation không tạo khe giả.
A04/A05/B07/C08/E02/E03/E05/E06/E07/E13 được chứng minh offline ở mức geometry.
tasks.note: 17 geometry regressions pass: analytic axes/quaternion basis, optical Z, crop/resize, stale/mismatched pose, wrap, new thin wire, pole, narrow gap, unknown/support holes and certificate conflict. Real API smoke changes forward middle-band free path from 4m to 1.75m on first one-row wire. 72x3 swept boxes cover whole 5deg sectors under explicit verified pixel-cone model. Local-clear sphere is explicit independent synthetic evidence, not inferred camera clearance; no SITL/sensor guarantee.

tasks.title: Braking envelope và command freshness offline
acceptance: API bound braking kiểm tra distance/margin/latency/actual velocity và invalid config.
Proposal stale không được refresh bởi heartbeat; unknown corridor không cấp quyền di chuyển.
Boundary fixtures gồm d<=margin, a<=0, NaN, stale epoch và vận tốc lệch hướng; không gọi đây là calibration SITL.
tasks.note: 16 braking/freshness regressions and actual API smoke pass: finite domain, d<=margin, independent stopping integration, speed clamp, signed reverse requires coverage, stale/old-epoch proposal rejection, measured side-slip/overspeed braking, stop-before-turn, vertical motion/origin mismatch rejection. Zero velocity is a request, not hover/calibration proof. No PX4 publishing or yaw-envelope guarantee.

tasks.title: Gate G0: offline smoke có thể tái lập
acceptance: Command thật chạy synthetic depth qua core đến histogram/safe proposal và xuất artifact có thể xem.
Tests hành vi cùng smoke đạt trên snapshot xác định; không có ROS node/runner giả.
tasks.note: G0 offline complete: 48 behavioral tests passed on unchanged core; final real CLI produces SVG, NPZ point clouds/histograms and JSON decisions. Wall 4m free =>3m/s cap; new one-row wire =>1.75m middle-band free and1.715m/s; unknown boot/stale proposal request zero motion. Final SVG visually inspected in existing Chromium with readable panel spacing. Added two-OS PR CI and integrity/portable-roadmap command; hosted CI not yet claimed. No ROS node, simulated flight logs or PX4 calibration fabricated.

tasks.title: Chọn và lock môi trường Linux PX4/ROS/Gazebo
acceptance: Người dùng cho phép mọi install/download cần thiết; thiếu prerequisite thì block rõ.
Image/packages/firmware/messages/Agent/assets được pin sau smoke, không suy luận từ tên image.
X500 depth, camera encoding/CameraInfo, odom, clock/QoS/namespace được quan sát thật, chưa arm.
tasks.note: Approved derived-image build; exact base + 13 package versions/archive SHA-256, installed versions and Agent hash recorded. Real X500 depth ROS 32FC1/CameraInfo/clock/QoS/optical TF + DDS odometry passed with documented UXRCE_DDS_SYNCT=0 simulation-time policy, 35 paired frames and Disarmed status only. Evidence docs/environments/g1-bridge-observation.json retains two failed prior default-clock windows. Owned containers cleaned. Environment only; no oracle, supervisor, flight or calibration acceptance.

tasks.title: Oracle contact/clearance và logger trước chuyến bay
acceptance: Known-free/known-contact fixture chứng minh observer sống, geometry/propeller envelope và landing-contact allowlist đúng.
Record phase-aware clearance, contact ledger và raw logs; planner không đọc oracle.
Oracle mất dữ liệu không thành zero collision; unsafe latch không bị infra ghi đè.
tasks.note: Pinned unarmed same-bag replay: support 385 samples; body intersection 285; rotor sweep intersection 281; truth loss before unsafe UNKNOWN/INFRA 73; truth loss after unsafe UNSAFE/INFRA 75. Exact gear support pairs never exempt body/rotor. Native sdformat14 and all visual/collision assets bound in 42-part profile. Independent typed clearance 0.7724005 m matches analytic value. 344 offline tests plus 13 archive tests; project integrity checks 53 evidence hashes. Retained all failed attempts and original bags in docs/replay/oracle-static-01; details docs/G1_ORACLE_RESULTS.md. Sampled static geometry only, no inter-sample swept-volume or flight certificate. No arming or control publisher.

tasks.title: Supervisor tối thiểu và single-owner Offboard bridge
acceptance: Supervisor/bridge độc lập planner/inference, explicit command TTL/epoch/progress.
Prime/ack/mode/arm ownership, unused PX4 fields và handoff có contract đúng firmware.
Stationary fault injection chứng minh stale command/owner conflict không cấp chuyển động; chưa coi đã test phanh bay.
tasks.blocker: Authorized code/offline slice complete: guarded actual pinned PX4 serialization and lifecycle smoke passed with zero init/nodes/control publishers. Runtime stationary fault injection/ownership and handoff remain unverified and outside approval; no arming or publisher authorization. Runtime gate intentionally incomplete.
tasks.note: User approved full code and offline pinned-message verification only. No control publisher is to be instantiated; no arming. Runtime gate must remain uncompleted.

tasks.title: Mission trống: takeoff, square, hold, land, disarm
acceptance: Trong known-clear test volume, bay vuông cạnh 5 m, goal hold, land/disarm có bag/ULog/ack thật.
Có bounded speed thăm dò, operator stop và supervisor; không disable preflight.
Phase-aware floor/landing contact không false-fail, tiếp xúc vật cản khác luôn fail.

tasks.title: Gate G1: đo stopping envelope và fault handoff
acceptance: Đo delay/braking/jerk/tracking theo actual motion và mức tải; đóng băng bounds/deadlines cùng safety config.
C02–C04/E09–E12/E21–E23 được thử đúng component đã có; bridge chết và PX4 rời Offboard không reclaim.
Camera/pose mất được xử lý theo mode đã test; không hứa hover/land an toàn vô điều kiện.

tasks.title: Depth adapter và capture-time obstacle evidence
acceptance: Sensor semantics/TF/calibration được xác minh; capture-time pose và epoch được giữ.
Không lọc mất near evidence; finite sampling/FOV/height-envelope giới hạn được ghi rõ.

tasks.title: Bag replay và lỗi cảm biến có kiểm soát
acceptance: Bag thật phát lại ở epoch mới; sensor dropout/blur/flicker có trace injection và oracle.
A01–A10/E01–E08/E13/E14/E24/E25 được phân biệt pure fixture với sensor-specific SITL.

tasks.title: Gate G2: wall-stop 10/10 qua supervisor thật
acceptance: 10/10 tiếp cận tường ngoài stopping envelope, không contact/clearance violation theo oracle.
Actual velocity, wall/sim latency và data age có log; Collision Prevention debug không được tính là bảo vệ Offboard.

tasks.title: Local planner có hysteresis và goal hold
acceptance: Planner thật tạo velocity/yaw proposals có hạn dùng, không đọc ground truth.
Corridor/cột/goal yaw-wrap/oscillation được thử; unknown hướng khác không bị xem free.

tasks.title: Bounded recovery và mission transitions
acceptance: B01–B05 và A08/E16/E17 có controlled run; không lùi mù hay quay khi envelope unsafe.
Retries/state transition/deadline cố định trước test; unreachable goal safe abort riêng.

tasks.title: Single-world executor và fault injection harness
acceptance: Run/attempt ownership, start/preflight/execute/collect/cleanup hoạt động trên scenario SITL thật.
Known failure/contact/infra trace được phân loại đúng và giữ mọi artifact; exit 0/1/2 đúng contract.

tasks.title: Safety/observer fault regression suite
acceptance: A–D/E/F trong phạm vi G3 có oracle và evidence index; ML cases để G4.
Impossible-spawn/dynamic stress kiểm tra phân loại, không trộn với zero-collision navigation benchmark.
Shutdown/telemetry-loss không che unsafe event đã quan sát.

tasks.title: World validator và seed split đóng băng
acceptance: Oracle route bảo toàn footprint/margin, fixed-altitude connectivity và segment/corner collision; không chỉ grid-center A*.
Dev/test seeds cùng noise/assets/config được đóng băng trước test, rejection ledger không loại theo planner outcome.
Oracle route là efficiency reference, không gọi là tối ưu động lực học nếu chưa chứng minh.

tasks.title: Batch evaluator và chống làm đẹp mẫu số
acceptance: 50 world test hợp lệ chạy đủ first attempts; retries/infra/missing/duplicates báo riêng.
Wilson CI, outcome counts, clearance window, route time ratio, latency/deadline/RTF và artifact links được xuất thật.
Không unsafe/infra bị success hoặc overwrite; incomplete batch không exit 0.

tasks.title: Gate G3: chấp nhận navigation sim-depth
acceptance: Ít nhất 45/50 SUCCESS trên frozen navigation suite, zero unsafe event, navigation surface clearance>=0.5 m.
Time-to-goal/latency gates có protocol và calibration; required safety cases pass theo suite semantics.
Report/demo/raw evidence cùng revisions có thể tái lập; không tuyên bố xác suất tổng quát>=90% hoặc an toàn bay thật.

tasks.title: Stereo SGBM và gate metric offline
acceptance: Stereo pairs đồng bộ/rectified, baseline/intrinsics/unit valid, uncertainty/dropout được giữ.
So với sim truth offline theo near-field overestimation và latency; không dùng truth chỉnh online.
Chỉ bay khi source mới đủ safety bounds; rerun scenario áp dụng.

tasks.title: Monocular metric adapter và OOD safety gate
acceptance: Exact checkpoint/license/preprocess/weights revision được pin; metric scale/focal sau resize/crop được chứng minh.
E18/E19/F06 offline pass trước control; relative depth không được so ngưỡng mét.
Không train/fine-tune hoặc tải weights khi chưa được phép; thiếu hardware/latency thì block, không fake fallback.

tasks.title: Gate G4: so nguồn depth trên cùng worlds
acceptance: Mỗi source được công bố đạt ít nhất 40/50 trên frozen 50 worlds, giữ zero unsafe event và clearance gate.
Báo accuracy/uncertainty/latency/RTF/source-specific failures và evidence riêng; kết quả sim-depth không được tái dùng để certify model.

tasks.title: Bàn giao project mô phỏng và hướng dẫn tái lập
acceptance: README/setup/run/evaluate commands khớp sản phẩm, dependency pins và artifact provenance đầy đủ.
Demo thực, limitations và license/dependency notes; không phát hành weights/assets trái license.
Code/test/docs cùng revision, không placeholder/no-op và không gọi đó là bay thật.

tasks.title: Quyết định G5 tuỳ chọn: map, VIO, planner hay hardware
acceptance: Người dùng chọn một hướng và xác nhận phạm vi/tiêu chí mới; không tự mua hoặc triển khai hardware.
Thêm task triển khai có dependency/evidence thật sau quyết định; không coi task lựa chọn là đã tích hợp G5.

tasks.title: Unarmed sensor recording and offline geometry replay
acceptance: Capture a bounded real Gazebo bag with depth, CameraInfo, clock, static TF, PX4 odometry and vehicle status in the pinned environment; remain Disarmed with no control publishers or arming commands.

Replay paired observations with validated capture-time timestamp_sample poses, full capture orientation, explicit frame conventions and reset/epoch handling; reject missing, stale, future, unsupported or unbracketed inputs.

Compare reconstructed geometry with independent declared targets using regions, alignment and effective numeric criteria fixed before grading; report per-target support and errors without using oracle geometry as navigation free-space evidence.

Exercise dropout/gap/reset replay variants and preserve the spike's near-hazard, empty-grid and sensor-range guards; report a stationary blind-zone STOP honestly and do not count synthetic liveness as real-data navigation.

Deliver reproducible bags/manifests, replay figures and exercised checks in English; this preparation branch does not complete G1 flight/calibration, G2 adapter/replay acceptance or wall-stop, and does not relax their dependencies.
tasks.note: Fresh 30.0508 s unarmed recording; 152/152 post-warmup frames paired with timestamp_sample/full orientation. Every declared target/frame passes unchanged 95% support, 0.10 m p95 and 0.20 m maximum limits; six explicit fault variants and stale gating pass. 117 offline tests pass. Corrected merged-SDF body origin and physical-surface grading before fresh capture; prior failures and raw bags remain preserved with archive readback hashes. English results, source-bound provenance, replay commands and inspected figures are in docs/SENSOR_REPLAY_RESULTS.md and docs/replay/unarmed-r35/. Stationary STOP remains honest; no control publisher, arming, flight, G1 calibration/G2 completion or dependency relaxation. Owned container removed; Docker/images retained.

tasks.title: Bind replay alignment epochs and recording evidence integrity
acceptance: Freeze world-to-odometry alignment from capture-time bracketed poses and bind it to the recorded reset/clock epoch; reset, mismatch or excessive alignment gap invalidates world grading instead of silently reusing a transform.

Require fresh depth, CameraInfo, odometry, clock and Disarmed status throughout bounded unarmed recording; preserve explicit incomplete reasons for stream loss and record subscriber/publisher QoS and monotonic receive progress.

Report available simulation/wall duration, RTF, image gaps, pairing versus availability and estimator uncertainty honestly; old bags missing wall/epoch provenance remain explicitly historical rather than acquiring fabricated metadata.

CI verifies every published evidence checksum and applicable archive/fixture identities on Windows and Linux; exercise actual pinned-schema bag decoding and reset/dropout failures without arm, control publishers, installation or altered historical evidence.
tasks.note: Final real 90.003 s Disarmed acquisition spans 19.328 s simulation with 445 images, 587 CameraInfo, 1933 odometry and 39 status messages. Strict receive trace and snapshot/reset reconstruction pass under unchanged 100 ms lead/1.5 s clock limits. Sim ages use node ROS-time snapshots rather than a queued clock callback. Storage is isolated in a finite 128-item process queue; worker completion/counts are mandatory, backpressure/error fails explicitly. Retained two failed long attempts: queued callback lead and synchronous disk stall. Updated geometry regression numbers, unknown QoS fields, missing checksum inventory detection and provenance-only legacy exits. 55 targeted boundary/model checks passed; final full-suite/CI remain publication gates for the combined authorized preparation work.

tasks.title: Derive pinned physical geometry and rerun corrected-mount liveness
acceptance: Derive base-link-relative asymmetric collision bounds and rotating propeller sweep from the pinned model, preserve source identities and distinguish physical geometry from phase clearance and localization/tracking/angular budgets.

Use the SDF-derived optical mount for new experiments while preserving explicitly labeled historical fixtures; rerun liveness with mount and effective envelope together rather than reusing the old one-metre admission claim.

Exercise known points on gear, body and propeller sweep and report unsupported mesh/attitude assumptions; these preparation results are reusable inputs, not completion of the g1-oracle contact ledger or flight calibration.
tasks.note: Pinned exact SDF collision boxes plus full rotor sweep yield FLU z [-0.227,0.0604231] m, radius 0.3859447 m and optical mount (0.13233,0,0.02078) m. New camera defaults use the body-relative mount; historical regressions pass old mount explicitly. Known gear/prop extremes, inflation-once and unsupported geometry/tilt regressions pass. Executed 96 declared historical/corrected/model-envelope cases using r39 observed XY/Z spans only as uncalibrated illustrative floors. On the tested grid, straight model navigation proxy first covers at 2.5 m; pitched/climb histories retain TOO_CLOSE and may have no allowed case. Visual-mesh completeness, tilted motion, tracking/angular/calibrated pose budgets remain explicitly unresolved; no flight or oracle/contact acceptance. Sources, profile, every case and hashes preserved in docs/replay/model-profile-r51/.

tasks.title: Observe rolling evidence expiry in a longer unarmed recording
acceptance: Capture a bounded stationary Disarmed sequence longer than the declared simulation-time evidence TTL under the integrity recorder; retain raw messages and wall/sim diagnostics with explicit limits and failure reasons.

Query during the real trace to demonstrate old frames expiring while fresh frames remain, then stale-all STOP; keep raw recordings immutable and distinguish temporal replay queries from sensor captures.
Do not teleport the vehicle, certify no-return semantics, claim positive real-data movement or waive G1/G2 dependencies; kinematic liveness remains a separately scoped decision.
tasks.note: Complete immutable 90.003 s Disarmed capture spans 19.328 s simulation with 10 s TTL; 429/429 post-warmup observations pair successfully. Actual prefix-only queries show 127 retained/0 expired, then 236 retained/24 expired, then 223 retained/206 expired; no future frames used. Subsequent query has NO_FRESH_FRAMES and zero retained. All six temporal checks pass. Separate strict long-bag geometry/fault replay also passes with explicitly reported worst errors ~5.3 cm, not a calibrated pose bound. Both incomplete attempts, complete bag, manifests, receive trace, source/environment provenance and frame identities preserved under docs/replay/ttl-r51/. No set_pose, control, real +Inf certification or positive navigation claim. Owned runtime/decoder removed; images retained. Model and acquisition results are documented; final full suite passed 143 tests, publication CI remains a separate gate.

tasks.title: Repair evidence semantics and measure truth-relative TTL error
acceptance: Finite near-depth hazards retain complete capture-pose pixel cones clipped at optical Z 0.3 m; negative infinity remains global fail-closed. Corrected rest fixtures derive from the complete physical profile without erasing retained hazards.

Pinned-decoder continuous truth measures absolute and all-pairs capture/query relative pose errors within TTL, with full quaternion angle, true ray range, body lever arm, clock-bracket coverage and uncalibrated non-admitting labels.

Independent retained-frame identity checks exercise a mid-trace camera gap longer than TTL, recovery and an early-only obstacle expiry variant. Actual replay compares historical and model-derived diagnostic envelopes without changing original ROI or grading thresholds.

Retain frozen sweep failures, baseline recordings, effective inputs and source hashes. An explicit supplemental project checker prevents completed G2 tasks while this preparation task is not done; no native dependency edge is claimed and no G1 task is blocked.
tasks.note: Implemented full finite-near cones with capture pose/uncertainty, complete-profile rest height, inclusive epoch/TTL identity checks and supplemental G2 checker. Actual pinned decoder:433 captures,1831 query times,315712 all-pairs up to exactly10s;11s camera gap/recovery and early-only obstacle expiry identities pass. Frozen1600 attempts and96 liveness cases retained. Both failed05 and complete disarmed06 bags preserved with hashes/source ZIPs. Primary geometry replay remains failed due documented side-target occlusion; original ROIs/thresholds unchanged, plane residual/coverage diagnostic complete. Stationary uncalibrated/nonadmitting only; supervisor runtime blocked, flight/calibration/G2 remain unmet.
